convertibility_reason: Uses custom signal filter CDC_PL_CCI from external .mqh library (Expert\Signal\MySignals\ACDC_PL_CCI.mqh). The trading logic is encapsulated in this custom class, requiring manual analysis of the custom indicator to replicate entry/exit rules in Python.

other_exits: Signal threshold close at 20 - CExpertSignal closes position when signal strength drops below Signal_ThresholdClose

position_sizing.conditional_logic: CMoneyFixedLot uses fixed lot size (0.1) with Percent parameter (10.0) as risk fraction reference, but lots are fixed regardless

custom_logic_notes: The core trading logic is entirely encapsulated in the CDC_PL_CCI custom signal filter class from ACDC_PL_CCI.mqh. The EA uses the standard MQL5 Expert Advisor framework (CExpert, CExpertSignal) with a threshold-based signal system: signals above 40 open positions, signals below 20 close positions. SL/TP are both set to 0 meaning the EA relies solely on signal reversal for exits. Expert_EveryTick=false means processing occurs once per bar, not every tick. Pending order expiration is set to 4 bars but PriceLevel=0 means market orders are used by default.
python_conversion_notes: Requires reading the ACDC_PL_CCI.mqh source to extract the actual CCI+MA crossover logic. The standard library classes (CExpert, CExpertSignal, CMoneyFixedLot, CTrailingNone) can be replaced with Python equivalents. The threshold-based signal system (open>=40, close<=20) maps to a scoring system. No SL/TP simplifies conversion. Fixed lot sizing is trivial. The main effort is reverse-engineering the CDC_PL_CCI::LongCondition() and ShortCondition() methods from the .mqh file to determine exactly how CCI and MA interact to produce the 0-100 signal strength values.
